probe_detail.name: Gives a mechanism for why the proposed approach should work
Distinguishes what is new here from what was already known
Extent of British rather than American spelling
Proportion of sentences written in the passive voice

final.name: Artifact-release signaling
final.audit_justification: It scores only the extent of release signaling, explicitly excluding usefulness or reproducibility, so it is a boilerplate/announcement marker rather than a quality judgment, though a habit of releasing artifacts may also track a more rigorous engineering culture.

final.name: Unifying Abstraction Across Regimes
final.audit_justification: Whether one principle genuinely unifies distinct settings with an explicit mapping is a substantive property of the idea's content and craft.

final.name: Resolution of Fundamental Trade-offs
final.audit_justification: Distinguishing a genuine trade-off-breaking insight from an incremental Pareto shift is a judgment about the scientific contribution itself.

final.name: Failure-Mechanism Fit
final.audit_justification: Whether a design targets a concrete diagnosed failure mechanism versus an unmotivated generic technique is a substantive methodological quality.

final.name: Claims specified precisely enough to be checked by a reader
final.audit_justification: Precision and checkability of claims (task, setting, comparison, measured quantity) is a core epistemic-rigor property, explicitly decoupled from excitement or phrasing.
final.parent: Concrete, vivid endpoint achievement stated in plain language

final.name: Density of currently fashionable technical terms and paradigm names
final.audit_justification: This counts occurrences of currently fashionable buzzwords and explicitly disclaims judging whether the work behind them is sound, making it a topic/fashion marker rather than trend-chasing that plausibly also drives genuine quality.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Trend-term concentration

final.name: Abstract Length Brevity
final.audit_justification: This is strictly a word-count measurement with quality of the length explicitly excluded, so it is a length/verbosity formatting marker, likely driven by venue conventions rather than a trait that also produces better research.

final.name: Domain-Valid Inductive Bias
final.audit_justification: Whether the architecture encodes and justifies a domain-appropriate symmetry or constraint is a substantive methodological design quality.

final.name: Amount of vivid, picturable, plain-language milestone phrasing
final.audit_justification: It measures the presence of vivid, easily-pictured milestone phrasing while explicitly disclaiming any judgment of truth or importance, making it a rhetorical/marketing style marker unlikely to track genuine quality.
final.parent: Concrete, vivid endpoint achievement stated in plain language
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Concrete, vivid endpoint achievement stated in plain language

final.name: Density of numeric performance claims and superlative comparisons
final.audit_justification: It counts numeric results and superlative phrases without verifying their truth or import, so it is a reporting-style density marker, though packing in many numeric comparisons can also stem from genuinely more thorough empirical evaluation.
final.upstream_parent: subfield and genre reporting convention (empirical-benchmark paper versus theory or analysis paper)

final.name: Trendy Topic Jargon Density
final.audit_justification: This is a near-duplicate buzzword-density count that explicitly disclaims judging the quality of the underlying research, so it is a topic/fashion marker rather than a quality-linked trait.

final.name: Raw textual volume in words and sentences
final.audit_justification: It measures raw word/sentence volume while explicitly disclaiming any judgment of padding or quality, making it a pure length marker rather than a quality-producing trait.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Abstract length / verbosity

final.name: Theory–Algorithm Closure
final.audit_justification: Whether formal assumptions, guarantees, or bounds actually characterize the proposed algorithm is a substantive rigor property of the content.

final.name: Cross-domain conceptual transfer
final.audit_justification: Explicitly importing and adapting a named concept from a distant field is a genuine novelty/craft property of the contribution.

final.name: Share of the text carrying specific technical content
final.audit_justification: This measures the length-normalized proportion of text carrying specific, checkable technical content as opposed to filler, which is a direct craft/substance property, not a raw-volume artifact.

final.name: Resource Accounting for Practicality
final.audit_justification: Whether computational cost, latency, or data requirements are quantified alongside claimed capability is a substantive transparency/rigor property of the reported work.

final.name: Identification of Hidden Flaws in Paradigms
final.audit_justification: Diagnosing a previously unrecognized flaw or bottleneck in a standard paradigm is a substantive intellectual-contribution property.

final.name: Signalled scale of compute, data, and evaluation breadth
final.audit_justification: It counts how much the abstract advertises resource scale while explicitly disclaiming any judgment of whether that scale is appropriate or necessary, so it is a resourcing/scale marker, though genuine access to larger compute or data can also produce better results.
final.upstream_parent: the producing group's compute budget, funding and headcount

final.name: Exact Mathematical Guarantees over Heuristics
final.audit_justification: Whether the method furnishes exact provable properties versus relying purely on heuristics is a substantive rigor property of the content.

final.name: Problem-solution template cadence
final.audit_justification: This scores only rhetorical structure (how closely the abstract follows a stock problem-method-experiment template), explicitly excluding judgment of the argument's quality, making it a template/formulaic-writing marker.
final.upstream_parent: author's practice in the abstract format

final.name: Contribution by subtraction or simplification
final.audit_justification: Whether a contribution advances by removing or simplifying machinery while preserving capability, versus purely adding stages, is a substantive methodological-contribution property.

final.name: Confound Isolation
final.audit_justification: Whether controls or ablations actually isolate competing explanations for an effect is a core experimental-rigor property of the content.

final.name: Artifact-availability boilerplate: code, data, project-page announcements
final.audit_justification: This is essentially the same release/availability-announcement extent as X01, explicitly excluding whether releasing is good practice or the artifact is valuable, though it may co-occur with a genuinely more rigorous reproducibility culture.
final.upstream_parent: the producing group's release practice and its compliance with venue and reproducibility norms (engineering support, legal clearance, institutional habit)

final.name: Names a live unsolved difficulty and its specific departure
final.audit_justification: Precisely naming a concrete obstacle and the specific departure taken in response is a substantive problem-framing/contribution property, explicitly decoupled from fashionable vocabulary.

final.name: Mechanistic explanation of why, not just what
final.audit_justification: Explaining the underlying causal mechanism for why an approach works, rather than only what was done, is a substantive explanatory-depth property of the content.
